purpose: Use one matching and AP-integration implementation for the prespecified two-class diagnostic on BDD and KITTI; keep the primary ten-class BDD and native KITTI results separately.
implementation: pycocotools==2.0.11 COCOeval, bbox mode; no modifications to its matching or accumulation code
integration: Arithmetic mean of the interpolated precision envelope at 101 recall points 0.00 to 1.00, then equal mean over ten IoU thresholds and two classes
box_convention: Continuous xywh pixel coordinates; area=width*height, no inclusive-pixel +1 convention
input_policy: Predictions are already filtered by the frozen all-class inference settings. The two-class core rejects more than 300 mapped predictions per image instead of silently truncating. It receives all image IDs, including images with zero predictions or no target-class ground truth.
empty_cases: No detections yields zero AP when target ground truth exists. An entirely missing ground-truth class raises an error instead of silently changing the macro-average denominator.
ignore_semantics: The generic core accepts only explicit COCO iscrowd flags and rejects a separate ambiguous ignore field. Crowd matching follows standard COCO intersection-over-detection-area semantics. The separately frozen common_annotation_policy.json specifies source-ignore compatibility and no-ignore sensitivity variants for KITTI; neither is the native KITTI benchmark metric.
dataset_mapping_status: Converters pass 15 synthetic checks, and every serialized target/ignore row has been independently compared to the pinned source-label archives. See common_annotation_build.json and common_annotation_source_verification.json. No real model predictions or scores have been evaluated.
not_yet_ready_for_real_external_evaluati: Durable per-image prediction archive/resume implementation, complete48endpoint/checkpoint manifest and final audits, native BDD actual-input geometry verification, all fixed evaluations and scientific analysis.
Native KITTI difficulty/neighbor-class/DontCare semantics remain separate; common AP is not official KITTI accuracy.
interpretation_limits: A shared AP core does not make the two datasets' annotation semantics, class definitions, ignore regions or sequence dependence identical. It cannot isolate a causal domain-shift effect, and the already-examined KITTI partition is not a fresh untouched holdout.
validation: 24 common-core cases and15 annotation-adapter checks pass on Windows and Linux;26 serialization cases pass on both. A33-synthetic-image CPU test verifies actual float32 forward shapes32x3x640x640 and1x3x640x640, ID/order/shape integrity and retained zero-area predictions. See prediction_io_correction_20261017.json and prediction_runtime_validation.json. No real model accuracy was evaluated.
zero_area_predictions: Retain image-edge-collapsed predictions. COCO bbox IoU returns zero; they remain unmatched false positives in the all-area common metric. Ground truth still requires positive area. This replaces the initial overly strict prediction guard after synthetic validation, before fixed-roster scoring.
